needs_human.note: A ?highlight= term retained by selectFile is applied to the next .md note selected, which may mark an unrelated passage through the partial-match fallbacks or scroll a note with no match to the top of its body (F1).; A note with no match for the term opens scrolled so that its frontmatter table is above the visible area (useHighlightPassage.ts:94-98); decisions.md records this as scrollTop 153 without saying it was chosen.; highlightSpent resets only on fileId and is set even when no highlight was ever present, so a new or first ?highlight= on the same mounted note after Read has been left is ignored (Editor.tsx:1276-1284). The only producer found in the code, the Ask page, is a separate page that opens the note afresh, so this needs a same-page link or a URL change on the mounted note.
A Markdown note picked after a citation-opened file inherits ?highlight= from the URL; it may then be marked by a partial match or scrolled past its top when nothing matches (F1).
